summary: Comprehensive testing of 11 new features (P0-P2). All 14 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: - BACKEND 1: Meeting join/leave auto-status (DND mode) - VERIFIED
- BACKEND 3: News push with DND skip (important/critical priority) - VERIFIED
- BACKEND 4: Scheduling poll confirm adds voters as participants - VERIFIED
- BACKEND 6: Global search returns grouped results - VERIFIED
- BACKEND 7: News audit log (admin-only, filter by action) - VERIFIED
- BACKEND 8: Recording AI summarize (400 if no content, 404 if not found) - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND Dashboard: mandatory-news-widget, pending-surveys-widget, pending-reports-widget - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND 6: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens command-palette-input, search works, ESC closes - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND 7: /admin?tab=audit-log shows audit-log-panel with table, filter, refresh - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND 8: RecordingsPage shows KI-Zusammenfassung buttons (summarize-{id}) - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND 9: /manifest.json accessible, index.html has PWA meta tags - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND 10: Keyboard shortcuts g+n, g+c, g+d, g+m, g+u all work - VERIFIED
- FRONTEND 11: Onboarding tour auto-displays, skip/next buttons work - VERIFIED
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 improvement features (P0-P2) have been implemented and tested. Key features: (1) Auto-status DND when joining meetings; (2) Push notifications skip DND users for important priority, bypass for critical; (3) Schedule poll confirm adds voters as meeting participants; (4) Surveys pending-count API; (5) Global search via Cmd+K; (6) Admin audit log with filtering; (7) AI recording summarization; (8) Dashboard action widgets; (9) PWA manifest; (10) Keyboard shortcuts; (11) Onboarding tour.
